ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM EITHER PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES AND (B) USD 1,000,000.

ops.text: Neither party shall be liable to the other for indirect or consequential damages. The foregoing cap does not apply to a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its fraud, or its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights. Customer's (Client's) payment obligations, and all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages for purposes of this Section.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the existing cap mutual and set it at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, because as drafted only TrueLink's liability is limited while Client's exposure is unlimited. The added sentence excludes indirect and consequential damages mutually, keeps confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, fraud and IP infringement (alongside the retained gross negligence and willful misconduct carve-out) outside the cap, and confirms Customer's payment obligations and all amounts due are not damages.
proposal.summary: Make the p0077 cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and add one sentence with the damages exclusion, remaining carve-outs and the payment-obligations statement.

mappings.element: Cap equal to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
Uncapped breach of data protection obligations.
Uncapped infringement of the other party's IP.
Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
